---
title: "1: The Origins of Courts"
---

What are courts and what is their purpose in society and politics? In this session we reflect on the intended functions of courts in societies, their history, common typologies of courts and why they are relevant for the study of politics. We also trace where the institutions we recognise today came from, from ancient dispute settlement to the medieval origins of the common and civil law traditions.
